name: duopore-public-explicit-decimal-normalizer
description: Put number text into one clear format when dots and commas mean different things.

interface.longDescription: Put number text into one clear format when dots and commas mean different things. Choose US or German number rules, then paste the values. Check signs, decimal places and grouped thousands. See values that need fixing instead of silently changing them. Currency signs and scientific number forms are not accepted. Each value must be within one million.
defaultPrompt: Convert these German decimal numbers to a consistent format.
Check these numbers for mixed dots and commas.

positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts.
